text:
amanda_sales: Quick help needed - ClearWave (Marta) can't finish Dedicated POC pool creation in ap-southeast-1a, getting reservation/affinity errors. Can we SWARM?

marta_clearwave: UI shows: `ProvisionError: ReservationConflict: requested az=ap-southeast-1a, reservation allows=[ap-southeast-1b, ap-southeast-1c]`

amanda_sales: they toggled single-az and multi-az, same. Also asking if switching AZs affects POC pricing/compliance.

raj_engineering: Is this using an explicit reservation id? If yes, payload from network would help.

marta_clearwave: pasted request from devtools:
```
POST /api/v1/dedicated/pools
{ "region": "ap-southeast-1", "az": "ap-southeast-1a", "gpu_type": "A10G", "reservation_id": "resv-42a9" }
```

provision-bot: Job 0x9f2 failed -> RESV_CONFLICT (reservation_id=resv-42a9; allowed_az=[ap-southeast-1b, ap-southeast-1c])

taylor_se: That explains it. resv-42a9 doesn't include 1a. Options: (1) create pool in b/c, (2) create a new reservation that includes 1a, (3) ops relax affinity.

amanda_sales: Customer security notes require AZ affinity. Do they need exactly 1a?

marta_clearwave: yes, on-prem gateway is pinned to 1a for latency/firewall rules.

raj_engineering: I'll request a short-lived reservation including 1a (resv-temp-1a) but need ops approval. ETA ~30m if approved. If capacity fragmented we might still fail, we'll see capacity snapshot.

amanda_sales: If you create that reservation under the POC program, will the customer be billed?

taylor_se: POC reservations are covered by trial credits for first 72h; no charge for demo if we keep within trial. We'll confirm with finance for anything longer. Provide an indicative daily rate for transparency.

marta_clearwave: also saw 429s earlier when retrying - could be hitting rate limits and making provisioning flaky.

raj_engineering: 429 likely from UI automated retries. If you can reproduce, do a single manual curl with 30s pause. Paste headers if it happens.

marta_clearwave: 429 headers: `x-rdwd-rate-limit: 60/min`, `x-rdwd-rate-remaining: 0`. They retried a bunch.

provision-bot: Capacity snapshot ap-southeast-1a A10G: reserved 2/8, used 5/8, available 1/8 - fragmentation risk.

raj_engineering: If resv-temp-1a can't be allocated due to fragmentation, fallback options: shift low-priority test workloads to 1b, relax affinity briefly (ops), or schedule a capacity compaction window.

amanda_sales: I'll escalate to ops and CS. Marta, which path do you want offered to the customer? fast (create trial reservation now) or scheduled (overnight capacity work)?

marta_clearwave: fast - demo tomorrow AM. Please prioritize.

ops-team: Acknowledged. Reviewing capacity and will respond shortly.

raj_engineering: Kicking off reservation request, tagging ops. Will update here when resv-temp-1a is provisioned. If approved, provisioning will retry with az=ap-southeast-1a.

amanda_sales: also flagged their KMS question: Dedicated POC uses platform KMS by default; customer-managed KMS available in Private/Enterprise. Sending doc link.

taylor_se: Once reservation exists I'll attempt pool create; if it fails we'll collect `/var/log/provisioner/*.log` and escalate to eng-runtime.

amanda_sales: thanks team, I'll keep the customer updated in the deal thread. :thumbsup:
